verses.text: Ibi ni vyo vyabaye mu gihe ca Ahasuwerusi, uwo Ahasuwerusi akaba yari umwami w’ibihugu ijana na mirongo ibiri n’indwi uhereye mu Buhindi ukageza muri Etiyopiya.
Muri ico gihe umwami Ahasuwerusi yaganza ari ku ntebe yiwe y’ubwami, iyo ntebe ikaba yari ku mugwa w’i Suza,
maze mu mwaka ugira gatatu w’ingoma yiwe ategurira amazimano abaganwa n’abanyacubahiro biwe. Abakuru b’ingabo z’Abaperesi n’iz’Abamedi, abaganwa n’abishikira bo mu ntara zose ni ho bari bari.
Imisi ijana na mirongo umunani yose yaheze ariko arerekana ubutunzi bwinshi, ugukayangana hamwe n’ubwiza vy’ubwo bwami bwiwe.
Iyo misi iheze, umwami arabazimana. Amazimano amara imisi indwi, bari ku kirimba iwe mu rugo rukikujwe n’uruzitiro. Kuva ku muntu mutoya ukageza ku mukuru, bose bari ngaho ku kirimba i Suza.

Urugo rwari rusharijwe n’ibitambara vy’amabara yera n’ayasa n’ubururu, biboshwe n’imigozi ikozwe mu mpuzu yera hamwe n’ibikoresho bisa n’agahama, bibohewe ku mizingi ikozwe mw’ifeza ku nkingi z’amabuye yo gushariza abajwe neza yitwa marubure. Intebe bicarako zari zikozwe mu nzahabu n’ifeza baziteretse ku musezero ukozwe muri porifiri na marubure n’ayandi mabuye y’agaciro kanini.
Umuvinyu watangwa mu bikombe vy’inzahabu, kimwe cose kidasa n’ikindi, kandi umuvinyu w’i bwami wari mwinshi cane, ku buryo umuntu wese yanywa uko ashatse kubera gutanga cane kw’umwami.
Umwami yari yavuze ko umuntu wese yatumiwe anywa uko ashaka, kuko umwami yari yategetse abatanga baha umuntu wese izo yipfuza.
Umwamikazi Vashiti na we nyene yariko arazimanira abagore ku kirimba c’umwami Ahasuwerusi.
Ku musi ugira indwi, umwami Ahasuwerusi amaze guhimba umuvinyu, atuma inkone ziwe indwi zamukorera; Mehumani, Bizita, Haribona, Bigita, Abagata, Zetari na Karukasi
ngo baje kuzana imbere yiwe umwamikazi Vashiti, yashajishije urugori rwiwe rw’ubwamikazi, kugira ngo abantu n’abaganwa barabe ubwiza bwiwe, kuko yari ateye igomwe.
Ariko za nkone zimubwiye ivyo umwami ategetse, umwamikazi Vashiti yanka kuza. Maze umwami araraka cane ishavu ryiwe rirurumba nk’umuriro.
Nk’uko vyari bimenyerewe ko umwami asiguza abahinga mu vy’amategeko no guca imanza, avugana n’abanyabwenge batahura ibijanye n’ibihe

kandi bari begereye rwose umwami. Abo na bo ni Karushena, Shetari, Adumata, Tarushishi, Meresi, Marusena na Memukani, abaganwa indwi b’i Buperesi n’i Bumedi bari abishikira badasanzwe ku mwami kandi bari abashizwe hejuru muri ubwo bwami.
Arababaza ati: “Amategeko, avuga iki, twokorera umwamikazi Vashiti? Ntiyumviye icagezwe c’umwami Ahasuwerusi yashikirijwe n’inkone.”

Maze Memukani yishurira imbere y’umwami n’abaganwa, ati: “Umwamikazi Vashiti yakoze nabi, kandi ntiyabikoreye umwami gusa ariko kandi yabikoreye n’abaganwa n’abantu bose bo mu ntara zose z’umwami Ahasuwerusi.

Kubera ko iyo nyifato y’umwamikazi izomenyekana mu bagore bose, hanyuma bagakengera abagabo babo bavuga bati: ‘Umwami Ahasuwerusi yategetse umwamikazi Vashiti ngo arenguke imbere yiwe, ariko aranka kugenda.’
Uwo musi nyene abagore b’abaganwa b’i Buperesi n’i Bumedi bumvise inyifato y’umwamikazi bazokwishura abaganwa nk’uko nyene. Ako gakengerwe kazoca kabandanya.

Nuko rero, nivyaba bihimbaye umwami, nasohore itegeko kandi ryandikwe mu vyagezwe vy’Abamedi n’Abaperesi, bidashobora guhinduka, ko Vashiti atazokwongera guseruka mu maso y’umwami Ahasuwerusi. Kandi ko umwami ahaye ico kibanza ciwe uwundi akibereye kumurusha.
Maze ico cagezwe c’umwami nicamamazwa mu bwami bwose, abagore bose bazokwubaha abagabo babo, uhereye ku muto ukageza ku mukuru.”
Umwami n’abaganwa bashima iyo mpanuro, maze umwami akora nk’uko Memukani yari yamugiriye inama.
Arungika amakete mu bice vyose vy’ubwami, intara yose akayandikira mu nyandiko yabo n’ihanga ryose akaryandikira mu rurimi rwabo kugira ngo umugabo wese aganze mu rugo rwiwe kandi avuge iryo ashatse.

headings.text: Vashiti yakwa iteka ryo kuba umwamikazi

verses.text: Uburake bw’umwami Ahasuwerusi bumaze kugabanuka, yibuka Vashiti n’ivyo yakoze, yibuka n’ingingo yamufatiye.
Maze abishikira b’umwami baja inama, bamubwira bati: “Umwami narondererwe inkumi nziza zitigeze ziryamana n’umugabo.

Umwami ashireho abantu mu ntara zose zo mu bwami bwiwe bazane abo bigeme bezabeza ku kirimba c’umwami i Suza. Baze babazeze Hegayi, inkone y’umwami, ajejwe abagore; kandi bahabwe ivyo kwitegura mu vyerekeye ubwiza bwabo.
Maze umwigeme azohimbara umwami azoce aba umwamikazi asubirire Vashiti.” Iyo mpanuro ihimbara umwami, na we arayikurikiza.
Kandi ku mugwa w’i Suza hari Umuyuda akomoka mu muryango wa Benyamini, yitwa Moridekayi mwene Yayiro, mwene Shimeyi, mwene Kishi,
umuryango wiwe wari waratwawe nk’inyagano na Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni uva i Yerusalemu, ujanwa hamwe na Yehoyakini umwami w’i Buyuda.

Uwo Moridekayi yari afise mushikabo yitwa Hadasa, yari yarareze kuko atagira se canke nyina. Uwo mwigeme, yitwa kandi Esiteri, yari mwiza ateye igomwe kuraba, kandi Moridekayi yari yaramutwaye amurera nk’umukobwa wiwe se na nyina bamaze gupfa.
Itegeko ry’umwami rimaze kwamamazwa, abigeme benshi bazanwa ku mugwa i Suza babazeza Hegayi. Esiteri na we nyene ajanwa ku kirimba c’i bwami ashikirizwa Hegayi, yari ajejwe iyo nzu y’abigeme.

Uwo mwigeme aramuhimbara, bituma amufata neza. Aca yihutira kumutegurira ivyo kwisiga n’ivyokurya bidasanzwe. Amushinga abaguranokazi indwi batoranijwe ku kirimba c’umwami aca amwimurira mu cumba ciza kuruta ibindi vyose vyo muri iyo nzu hamwe na ba bigeme biwe bo kumukorera.
Esiteri ntiyigeze avuga ubwoko bwiwe canke kahise k’umuryango wiwe, kuko Moridekayi yari yarabimubujije.
Imisi yose yama atembera i ruhande y’urugo rw’iyo nzu y’abigeme kugira ngo amenye uko Esiteri amerewe n’uko ivyiwe vyariko biragenda.

Imbere y’uko umwigeme wese aramukirwa kuja aho umwami Ahasuwerusi ari, yategerezwa kumara amezi icumi n’abiri ategurwa kugira ngo ase neza nk’uko vyari vyarashinzwe: amezi atandatu yayamara yisiga amavuta yitwa mirehi, ayandi mezi atandatu akayamara yisiga kandi yimotesha neza.
Igihe co kuja kubonana n’umwami kigeze, ico yashaka cose gutwara ava mu nzu y’abigeme aja ku kirimba c’umwami barakimuha.

Ku mugoroba yaca agendayo maze mu gitondo akavayo akaja mu yindi nzu y’incoreke yari irongowe na Shayashigazi, inkone y’umwami yari ashinzwe incoreke z’umwami. Ntiyasubira ku mwami kiretse yamuhimbaye maze akamutumako mw’izina.

Maze Esiteri wa mwigeme yari yarezwe na Moridekayi, yari umukobwa wa Abihayili sewabo wa Moridekayi, araramukirwa kuja kubonana n’umwami, ntiyagira ico asaba atari ivyo Hegayi, inkone y’umwami yari ajejwe iyo nzu yamubwiye gutwara. Kandi Esiteri yari afise igikundiro ku bamubona bose.
Maze ajanwa ku mwami Ahasuwerusi mu kirimba c’i bwami mu kwezi kw’icumi, kwitwa Tebeti, mu mwaka ugira indwi ari ku ngoma.

Umwami akunda Esiteri kurusha abandi bagore bose, agira ikiganza ciza kuri we aramuhimbara kurusha ba bigeme bandi bose. Nuko aca amwambika urugori rw’ubwami ku mutwe amugira umwamikazi wiwe asubirira Vashiti.
Maze umwami ategura amazimano ahambaye, ku bwa Esiteri, ayategurira abaganwa biwe n’abishikira biwe. Yamamaza ko haba umusi mukuru mu ntara zose kandi atanga ingabire z’i bwami.
Igihe ba bigeme bari bakoranye ubugira kabiri, Moridekayi yari yicaye kw’irembo ry’ikirimba c’umwami.
Ariko Esiteri yari yarahishije kahise k’umuryango wiwe n’ubwoko bwiwe nk’uko Moridekayi yari yaramubwiye, kandi yashishikaye gukurikiza impanuro za Moridekayi nk’uko yabikora akimureze.
Mu gihe Moridekayi yari yicaye kw’irembo ry’i bwami, Bigitana na Tereshi, babiri mu nkone z’umwami bari mu barinda irembo, bararaka maze bagira inama yo kwica umwami Ahasuwerusi.
Ariko Moridekayi amenya inama yabo araheza abimenyesha umwamikazi Esiteri, maze na we abishikiriza umwami, mw’izina rya Moridekayi.
Bamaze gutohoza neza iyo nkuru basanga ni yo, abo bakuru babiri bamanikwa ku biti. Ivyo vyose bica vyandikirwa imbere y’umwami mu bitabu vy’ibigenda biraba.

headings.text: Moridekayi amenya inama yo kwica umwami

verses.text: Inyuma y’ivyo, umwami Ahasuwerusi aha icubahiro Hamani mwene Hamedata, Umwagagi, amushira hejuru, amuha n’intebe y’icubahiro irengeye iz’abandi baganwa bose.

Abakozi bose bo kw’irembo ry’ikirimba i bwami barapfukamira Hamani bakamuha icubahiro, kuko umwami yari yarategetse ko babimukorera. Ariko Moridekayi ntiyigeze yemera kumwunamira canke ngo amuhe icubahiro.
Maze abakozi bo kw’irembo ryo ku kirimba c’umwami barabaza Moridekayi bati: “Ni kuki utubaha icagezwe c’umwami?”
Bakama uko bukeye uko bwije bamubaza batyo, ariko we ntabumvirize. Nuko babibwira Hamani ngo barabe uko bizogenda ku nyifato ya Moridekayi, kuko yari yarababwiye ko ari Umuyuda.
Hamani abonye ko Moridekayi atamwunamira canke ngo amuhe icubahiro, arashangashirwa.

Kubera yuko bari bamaze kumubwira ubwoko bwa Moridekayi, Hamani ntiyagomba kwica Moridekayi gusa, ariko agomba kwica ubwoko bwa Moridekayi bwose, ari bwo bw’Abayuda, aho bari hose mu bwami bwa Ahasuwerusi.

Mu mwaka ugira cumi na kabiri umwami Ahasuwerusi ari ku ngoma, mu kwezi kwa mbere ari kwo Nisani, bagirira ubupfindo bita puri imbere ya Hamani ngo bahitemwo umusi n’ukwezi. Maze ubupfindo bugwa ku kwezi kwa cumi na kabiri, ari kwo Adari.

Nuko Hamani abwira umwami Ahasuwerusi ati: “Hari ubwoko bwasanzariye mu mahanga yo mu ntara zose z’ubwami bwawe, bufise imigenzo itandukanye n’iy’ayandi mahanga yose kandi butubaha amategeko y’umwami; rero si vyiza kandi nta nyungu vyozanira umwami kuvyirengagiza.
Nivyaba bihimbaye umwami, nihashingwe icagezwe co kubamara, nanje nzotanga italato ibihumbi icumi z’ifeza ndazishire mu minwe y’abakozi b’umwami baraba ivy’intwaro bazishire mu bubiko bw’umwami.”
Maze umwami aca yiyambura ku rutoke impeta iriko ikashe, ayiha Hamani mwene Hamedata umwagagi, umwansi w’Abayuda.
Umwami abwira Hamani ati: “Ayo mahera nuyigumirize, maze ugire abo bantu uko ugomba.”

Maze ku musi ugira icumi na gatatu w’ukwezi kwa mbere, batumako abanditsi b’umwami. Bandikira amakete intara zose no mu ndimi z’amahanga yose ivyo Hamani ategetse abategetsi b’umwami, abatware b’intara zitandukanye hamwe n’abanyacubahiro baserukira imigwi itandukanye y’abantu. Vyari vyanditswe mw’izina ry’umwami Ahasuwerusi ubwiwe kandi biriko ikimenyetso co ku mpeta yiwe.

Ayo makete bayarungikana intumwa zija mu ntara zose umwami yatwara gushikiriza amategeko avuga ko bahonya, bakica kandi bakarandura Abayuda bose; abato n’abakuze, abagore n’abana bato, ku musi umwe washinzwe, ari wo musi ugira icumi na gatatu w’ukwezi kwa cumi na kabiri, ukwezi kwa Adari, no kubanyaga ivyo batunze vyose.
Ikopi y’ivyanditswe muri ico cagezwe yategerezwa gutangwa mu ntara zose bikamenyeshwa abantu bo mu bihugu vyose ngo bitegurire uwo musi.
Za ntumwa zigenda zihuta kubera itegeko ry’umwami, ico cagezwe kimenyeshwa abo mu gisagara c’i Suza. Umwami na Hamani baricara ngo banywe, ariko abantu bo mu gisagara c’i Suza baja mu ruhagarara.

headings.text: Inama ya Hamani yo kwica Abayuda

verses.text: Moridekayi amenye ivyabaye vyose, yitaburirako impuzu, yambara amagunira yisiga iminyota, aca aja mu gisagara, akoma induru y’umubabaro.
Ariko agarukira kw’irembo ry’ikirimba c’umwami, kuko ata muntu yambaye amagunira yari yemerewe kwinjira.
Mu ntara zose aho ico cagezwe c’umwami cashika, haca haba ikigandaro gikomeye mu Bayuda, gifatanije no kwisonzesha, kurira no kuboroga. Benshi bakaryama mu magunira bakisiga n’iminyota.
Maze incoreke hamwe n’inkone za Esiteri baraza bamubwira ivya Moridekayi, maze umwamikazi aca ahagarika umutima cane. Amurungikira impuzu ngo yambare areke kwambara amagunira, ariko ntiyazakira.
Nuko Esiteri atuma Hataki, umwe mu nkone z’umwami yashinzwe kumukorera, amutegeka kumenya ivyababaje Moridekayi n’icatumye akora gutyo.
Nuko Hataki arasohoka aja aho Moridekayi yari ari ku kibuga c’igisagara gitumberanye n’irembo ry’umwami.
Moridekayi amubwira ivyabaye vyose, n’igiciro c’amahera Hamani yasezeranye gutanga mu kigega c’umwami ngo Abayuda bahonywe.

Amuha n’ikopi ya ca cagezwe co kubamara, cakwiragijwe i Suza, ngo acereke Esiteri, bakimusigurire, kandi amutuma kubwira Esiteri ngo agende kuvugana n’Umwami amwinginge amusaba kugirira imbabazi ubwoko bwiwe.
Hataki arahindukira aja kubwira Esiteri ivyo Moridekayi yavuze vyose.
Nuko Esiteri aca yongera gutuma Hataki kubwira Moridekayi ati:

“Abaganwa b’umwami n’abantu bose bo mu ntara z’umwami barazi ko umuntu wese yaba umugabo canke umugore yokwegera aho umwami ari atamutumyeko, ko hari icagezwe kimwe gusa: ko uwo muntu akwiye kwicwa. Kiretse umwami amutumberejeko inkoni yiwe y’inzahabu, kugira ngo akize ubuzima bwiwe. Kandi ubu haciye imisi mirongo itatu umwami atantumyeko.”
Bamaze kubwira Moridekayi amajambo ya Esiteri,
na we aca amusubiza ati: “Ntiwiyumvire na gatoya ko kubera uri i bwami uzorokoka igihe Abayuda bose bazokwicirwa rimwe.

Kuko niwapfa kwinumira gusa mu gihe nk’iki, ugutabarwa kw’Abayuda no gukira bizova ahandi, ariko wewe n’inzu ya so muzohona. Kandi, nta wubizi ko kumbure icatumye ushika aho uba umwamikazi atari kugira ngo useruke mu gihe nk’iki?”
Maze Esiteri arungikira inyishu Moridekayi ati:

“Genda ukoranye Abayuda bose bari i Suza, mwisonzeshe ku bwanje. Mumare imisi itatu mutarya canke ngo munywe, haba mw’ijoro canke ku murango. Jewe n’incoreke zanje tuzokwisonzesha hamwe namwe. Ico gihe nicahera, nzoja kuraba umwami, naho binyuranye n’amategeko. Nimba ari ugupfa nshake mpfe.”
Nuko Moridekayi aca aragenda akora nk’uko Esiteri yamubwiye.

Ku musi ugira gatatu wo kwisonzesha, Esiteri yambara impuzu ziwe z’ubwamikazi, maze aragenda ahagarara hagati mu kirimba, aharabana n’ikibanza umwami yakiriramwo abantu. Umwami yari avyagiye ku ntebe yiwe y’ubwami iri aho hantu, araba mu rwinjiriro.
Abonye umwamikazi Esiteri ahagaze mu rugo, arahimbarwa aca amutumberezako inkoni yiwe y’inzahabu yari afise mu minwe. Maze Esiteri aca aregera akora kw’isonga ry’iyo nkoni.
Nuko umwami aramubaza ati: “Ni iki, ga mwamikazi Esiteri? Usaba iki? Naho coba igice c’ubwami, uragihabwa.”
Esiteri na we aramwishura ati: “Nivyaba bihimbaye umwami, ndamusavye aze ari kumwe na Hamani, gufungura ku mazimano namuteguriye uno musi.”
Umwami aca avuga ati: “Nimuzane Hamani ubu nyene, kugira ngo dukore ico Esiteri asavye.” Nuko umwami na Hamani baja ku mazimano Esiteri yari yateguye.
Bariko baranywa umuvinyu, umwami yongera kubaza Esiteri ati: “Ubu rero ni iki usaba? Uragihabwa. Wipfuza iki? Naho coba igice c’ubwami, uragihabwa.”
Esiteri aramwishura ati: “Ico nsaba ng’iki:

Ninaba ngiriwe ubuntu n’umwami kandi bikaba bihimbaye umwami kumpa ico nsavye, no gushitsa ico nipfuza, umwami na Hamani baze bagaruke ejo ku mazimano nzobategurira. Ico gihe nzoca nishura ikibazo umwami ambajije.”
Hamani asohoka kuri uwo musi anezerewe, umutima wiwe uhimbawe. Ariko abonye Moridekayi ari kw’irembo ry’umwami akabona ntamwunamiye canke ngo ahindire agashitsi imbere yiwe, arashavura cane.
Ariko Hamani arigumya aca aja iwe. Ahamagara abagenzi biwe na Zereshi, umugore wiwe,
aca atangura kwihayagiza kuri bo kubera itunga ryiwe ryinshi, abahungu benshi yari afise, n’uburyo bwose umwami yamuhaye icubahiro akamushira hejuru kuruta abandi baganwa bose n’abakuru bose.
Hamani yongerako ati: “Kandi si ivyo gusa, ni jewe jenyene umwamikazi Esiteri yatumiye ngo mperekeze umwami ku mazimano yari yateguye. Kandi yongeye arantumira ngo nzojane n’umwami ejo.
Ariko ivyo vyose nta co bimariye nkibona urya Muyuda Moridekayi yicaye ku kirimba c’umwami.”

Umugore wiwe Zereshi n’abagenzi biwe bose baca bamubwira bati: “Shinga igiti c’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itanu z’uburebure, uce usaba umwami kumanika Moridekayi kuri ico giti. Hanyuma ubone kugenda ku mazimano hamwe n’umwami unezerewe.” Iyo mpanuro inezera Hamani, maze ashinga ico giti.
Muri iryo joro umwami abura itiro; nuko ategeka ko bamuzanira ibitabu bandikamwo ibigenda biraba, ivyo banditse vyabaye ku ngoma yiwe, ategeka ko babizana bakabimusomera.
Bashikira ahantu handitswemwo ingene Moridekayi yatanze inkuru ivuga ko inkone zibiri Bigitana na Tereshi, bacungera irembo, bari bagiye inama yo kwica umwami Ahasuwerusi.
Umwami aca abaza ati: “Mbega ni ikihe cubahiro n’ishimwe Moridekayi yahawe ku bw’ivyo?” Abakozi biwe bamwishura bati: “Nta na kimwe yahawe.”
Umwami aca avuga ati: “Ni nde ari ngaho mu rugo?” Hamani yari yinjiye ashitse mu rugo rw’ikirimba aje kubwira umwami ivyerekeye kumanika Moridekayi ku giti yari yamushingiye.
Abakozi bamwishura bati: “Hamani ni we ahagaze mu rugo.” Umwami aca ategeka ati: “Nimumwinjize.”
Hamani yinjiye, umwami aramubaza ati: “Mbega umuntu umwami agomvye guha icubahiro yomukorera iki?” Maze Hamani ariyumvira ati: “Hari uwundi muntu umwami yoba agomba guha icubahiro atari jewe?”
Nuko yishura umwami ati: “Umuntu umwami ashimye guha icubahiro,
bomuzanira impuzu y’ubwami umwami yahoze yambara, bakazana n’ifarasi umwami yagendeyeko, imwe yambaye urugori rw’ubwami ku mutwe.

Hanyuma iyo mpuzu n’iyo farasi bakabiha umwe mu baganwa arusha abandi gutona ku mwami. Hanyuma boca bambika ya mpuzu uwo muntu umwami ashimye guha icubahiro, bakamwicarika kuri ya farasi bakamutembereza mu mabarabara yo mu gisagara, basemerera imbere yiwe bati: ‘Uku ni ko uwo umwami agomvye guha icubahiro agirirwa!’ ”
Umwami aca ategeka Hamani ati: “Genda wihuta, wakire iyo mpuzu n’iyo farasi ukorere ivyo uvuze Moridekayi Umuyuda, yicaye ku kirimba c’umwami. Ntihagire na kimwe ukuramwo mu vyo wavuze.”

Nuko Hamani yakira ya kanzu na ya farasi. Yambika Moridekayi amushira kuri ya farasi amuja imbere amutembereza mu mabarabara yo mu gisagara, agenda arasemerera ati: “Uku ni ko uwo umwami ashimye guha icubahiro agirirwa!”
Inyuma y’ivyo Moridekayi agaruka ku kirimba c’umwami. Ariko Hamani yihuta kuja iwe, yicurikiriye yipfutse mu mutwe,

aca abwira Zereshi umugore wiwe n’abagenzi biwe ivyamubayeko vyose. Abahanuzi biwe n’umugore wiwe Zereshi baramubwira bati: “Nimba Moridekayi, uwo utanguye gucishwa bugufi imbere, ari Umuyuda, ntuzomushobora. Mbere uzokomeza inzira yo kugesezwa imbere yiwe!”
Bakiriko baravugana na we, inkone y’umwami irashika yihutisha Hamani ngo anyaruke aje ku mazimano Esiteri yari yateguye.
Nuko umwami na Hamani baja gusangira n’umwamikazi Esiteri,
maze ku musi ugira kabiri, bariko baranywa umuvinyu, umwami yongera kubaza ati: “Mwamikazi Esiteri, usaba iki? Ico usaba uragihabwa. Vuga ico usaba, naho coba igice c’ubwami, uragihabwa.”
Maze umwamikazi Esiteri aramwishura ati: “Ninaba ngiriwe ubuntu imbere yawe, mwami, kandi nivyaba biguhimbaye, ukingire ubuzima bwanje, kandi wongere ukize n’ubwoko bwacu. Ico ni co nsaba.
Kuko jewe n’ubwoko bwacu twaragurishijwe ngo turandurwe kandi ngo duherengetezwe. Iyo tuba twagurishijwe ngo tube abagurano n’abaguranokazi, nari guhora, kuko bitari kuba bikenewe ko ngora umwami.”
Umwami Ahasuwerusi abaza umwamikazi Esiteri ati: “Ni nde? Uwo muntu ari he yubahutse gukora ikintu nk’ico?”
Esiteri avuga ati: “Uwo mwansi kandi w’umuyobe mubi ni uwu Hamani.” Maze Hamani aca agwa igihumura aho nyene imbere y’umwami n’umwamikazi.

Umwami ava hasi n’uburake bwinshi, ava aho yariko aranywera, asohoka hanze mu rugo rw’ikirimba. Ariko Hamani, abonye ko umwami yamaze gufata ingingo yo kumwica, asigara inyuma ngo yinginge umwamikazi Esiteri amukirize ubugingo.

Umwami agarutse avuye hanze aja aho bariko barazimanirwa, asanga Hamani yikubise hasi ku ntebe Esiteri yari yicayeko. Umwami yiha akamo ati: “Noneho agomba akorere ibiterasoni umwamikazi mu maso yanje hano mu kirimba?” Iryo jambo rikiva mu kanwa k’umwami, baca bapfuka Hamani mu maso.

Nuko Haribona, umwe mu nkone zakorera umwami, aca avuga ati: “Hariho igiti c’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko mirongo itanu gihagaze imbere y’inzu kwa Hamani. Yari yagishinze ngo akimanikeko Moridekayi, umwe yavuze ivyo gukiza umwami.” Umwami aravuga ati: “Nimukimumanikeko!”
Nuko bamanika Hamani kuri ca giti yari yateguriye Moridekayi. Maze uburake bw’umwami burahwama.

Kuri uwo musi nyene umwami Ahasuwerusi aca aha umwamikazi Esiteri ibintu vyose vyari ivya Hamani, umwansi w’Abayuda. Maze Moridekayi aca ararenguka imbere y’umwami, kuko Esiteri yari yamaze kuvuga ico bapfana.
Umwami aca akura impeta yo ku rutoke rwiwe yari yatse Hamani ayiha Moridekayi. Kandi Esiteri aca aha Moridekayi kugaba ibintu vyose vyari ivya Hamani.
Esiteri asubira kwinginga umwami, yubamye ku birenge vyiwe arira. Amwinginga ngo ahagarike umugambi mubi wa Hamani Umwagagi, uwo yari yarateguye wo kumara Abayuda.
Maze umwami atunga ya nkoni y’inzahabu Esiteri na we aca arahaguruka ahagarara imbere yiwe.

Aravuga ati: “Nivyaba bihimbaye umwami, kandi nkaba ngiriwe ubuntu imbere yiwe bikongera bikaba ari vyiza, kandi nkaba ndamuhimbaye, nihandikwe icete kivuguruza kimwe Hamani mwene Hamedata, Umwagagi, yari yashinze co kumara Abayuda mu ntara zose z’umwami.
None mbega nokwihanganira nte kubona ubwoko bwacu buhona? Nokwihanganira nte kubona umuryango wanje uherengetezwa?”
Umwami Ahasuwerusi yishura umwamikazi Esiteri na Moridekayi Umuyuda ati: “Kubera Hamani yagwanije Abayuda, inzu yiwe nayihaye Esiteri, kandi bamumanitse ku giti yishingiye.

Ubu rero nimwandike ikindi cagezwe mw’izina ry’umwami gikingira Abayuda nk’uko mubona vyobabera vyiza, mugishireko ikimenyetso co ku mpeta y’umwami, kuko ata canditswe mw’izina ry’umwami cashizweko ikimenyetso c’umwami gishobora guhindurwa.”

Ubwo nyene baca batumako abanditsi b’umwami; ku musi ugira mirongo ibiri na gatatu w’ukwezi kwa gatatu, ari kwo kwitwa Sivani. Bandika ivyo Moridekayi ategetse Abayuda, n’abakuru, n’abatwara intara n’abishikira bo mu ntara ijana na mirongo ibiri n’indwi uhereye mu Buhindi ukageza muri Etiyopiya. Ayo mategeko yari yanditse mu nyandiko zo muri izo ntara zose no mu rurimi rw’ihanga ryose n’Abayuda na bo nyene babibarungikira mu nyandiko no mu rurimi rwabo.
Moridekayi yandika mw’izina ry’umwami Ahasuwerusi, asinya kuri ayo makete akoresheje ya mpeta y’umwami, abirungikana intumwa zigenda n’amafarasi anyaruka cane zamenyereye gukora ibikorwa vy’umwami.

Ico cagezwe c’umwami cemerera Abayuda aho bari hose mu bisagara vyose gukoranira hamwe no kwigwanira, kwica, guhonya no guherengeteza abitwaje ibigwanisho bo mu bihugu vyose canke intara zose boshobora kuza kubatera bo n’abagore n’abana babo; no kunyaga ibintu vy’abansi babo vyose.
Umusi washinzwe ngo Abayuda bakore ivyo mu ntara zose z’umwami Ahasuwerusi, wari umusi w’icumi na gatatu w’ukwezi kwa cumi na kabiri ari kwo kwezi kwa Adari.
Ikopi y’iryo kete itangwa mu ntara zose iba nk’itegeko kandi imenyeshwa abantu bose b’ibihugu vyose kugira ngo Abayuda bitegure kuri uwo musi kwihora abansi babo.
Za ntumwa ziragenda, ziri ku mafarasi y’umwami, kubera ico cagezwe c’umwami. Kandi ico cagezwe gikwiragizwa no ku mugwa i Suza.

Moridekayi ava imbere y’umwami yambaye impuzu z’i bwami z’amabara y’ubururu n’ayera, n’urugori runini rw’inzahabu n’ikanzu y’agahama ikoze mu nyuzi nziza. Maze abo mu gisagara i Suza bagira umusi mukuru.
Abayuda bari banezerewe bahimbawe, batewe iteka.

Mu ntara zose no mu bisagara vyose, aho ico cagezwe c’umwami cashika, haca haba umunezero n’agahimbare mu Bayuda, bakagira umusi mukuru batamba. Kandi abantu benshi bo mu yandi mahanga bahinduka Abayuda babitewe n’uko ubwoba bwinshi bwo gutinya Abayuda bwari bwabatekeye.

Ku musi wa cumi na gatatu w’ukwezi kwa cumi na kabiri, ari kwo bita Adari, icagezwe casohowe n’umwami categerezwa gushirwa mu ngiro. Kuri uwo musi abansi b’Abayuda bari bizigiye kubanesha, ariko birahinduka maze Abayuda banesha abansi babo.

Abayuda bakoranira mu bisagara vyabo mu ntara zose z’umwami Ahasuwerusi ngo batere abarondera kubica. Nta n’umwe yashoboye kubahagarara imbere, kuko abantu bose bo mu bundi bwoko baciye babatinya cane.
Kandi abakuru bo mu ntara, abatwarira umwami, abakuru b’intara n’abandi bafasha umwami gutwara baca bafasha Abayuda, kuko bari batekewe n’ubwoba batinya Moridekayi.
Moridekayi yari yabaye agakomeye ku kirimba; ukumenyekana kwiwe gukwira mu ntara zose, kandi akomeza kuba umunyabushobozi.
Abayuda batsinda abansi babo babamarisha inkota, barabica, barabatikiza, kandi bakora ico cose bipfuza ku bansi babo.
Ku mugwa w’i Suza, Abayuda bica abagabo amajana atanu.
Bica na Parishandata, Dalufoni, Asipata,
Porata, Adaliya, Aridata,
Parumashita, Arisayi, Aridayi na Vayizata,
abahungu cumi ba Hamani mwene Hamedata, umwansi w’Abayuda. Ariko ntibakora ku kintu na kimwe ngo bagisahure.
Igitigiri c’abishwe ku mugwa i Suza kimenyeshwa umwami kuri uwo musi nyene.

Umwami abwira umwamikazi Esiteri ati: “Abayuda bishe bakuraho abagabo amajana atanu n’abahungu cumi ba Hamani ku mugwa i Suza. Nimba bakoze ivyo ngaha, mu zindi ntara z’ubwami ho bakoze iki? None rero ubu hari ikindi usaba? Na co uragihabwa. Vuga ico ukeneye cose, na co nyene urakironka.”
Esiteri aramwishura ati: “Nivyaba bihimbaye umwami, niyemerere Abayuda bari i Suza gushishikara gushira mu ngiro ca cagezwe no ku musi w’ejo, kandi ba bahungu cumi ba Hamani bamanikwe ku giti.”
Nuko umwami ategeka ko n’ivyo bikorwa, icagezwe kirasohoka i Suza, maze baca bamanika ba bahungu cumi ba Hamani.
Abayuda b’i Suza barakorana ku musi ugira cumi na kane w’ukwezi kwa Adari, bica i Suza abagabo amajana atanu, ariko ntibagira ico basahura.
Muri ico gihe, Abayuda basigaye bo mu zindi ntara umwami yatwara na bo nyene barakorana ngo bigwanire, bivune abansi babo. Bica ibihumbi mirongo indwi na bitanu muri bo ariko ntibakora kw’isahu.
Ivyo vyashitse ku musi wa cumi na gatatu w’ukwezi kwa Adari, maze ku musi wa cumi na kane bararuhuka kandi bawugira umusi mukuru wo guhimbaza n’uwo umunezero.
Ariko Abayuda b’i Suza bari bakoraniye hamwe ku musi wa cumi na gatatu n’umusi wa cumi na kane, maze ku musi ugira cumi na gatanu bararuhuka baca bawugira umusi w’umunezero no guhimbaza.
Ni co gituma Abayuda bo mu misozi, ababa mu bigwati, bahimbaza umusi wa cumi na kane w’ukwezi kwa Adari nk’umusi w’umunezero no guhimbaza, umusi wo guhanahana ingabire.
Moridekayi yandika ivyo vyabaye, kandi arungika amakete ku Bayuda bose bari mu ntara zose z’umwami Ahasuwerusi, aba hafi n’aba kure,
ngo baze bame bahimbaza uko umwaka utashe imisi ya cumi na kane na cumi na gatanu y’ukwezi kwa Adari

nk’igihe Abayuda bivuna abansi babo, kandi nk’ukwezi umubabaro wabo wahindutsemwo umunezero, ukugandara kwabo kugahindukamwo umusi wo guhimbaza. Abandikira ngo baze bafate iyo misi nk’imisi mikuru y’umunezero no guhanahana ingabire z’ivyokurya n’ingabire ku bakene.
Nuko Abayuda baravyemera ko bazoshishikara ukwo kwiginana bari batanguye, bagakora ivyo Moridekayi yabandikiye.
Kuko Hamani mwene Hamedata Umwagagi, umwansi w’Abayuda, yari yagiye inama yo kwica Abayuda akagira ubupfindo bita puri kugira ngo abaherengeteze abamare kuri iryo genekerezo.
Ariko bimaze gushika imbere y’umwami, arungika amategeko yanditse kugira ngo izo nama mbi Hamani yari yagiriye Abayuda zisubire ku mutwe wiwe ubwiwe, kandi ngo abahungu biwe bamanikwe ku biti.
Nuko iyo misi yitwa Purimu, ijambo rivuye mw’ijambo puri . Kubera ikintu cose canditswe muri iryo kete no kubera ko bari babonye ivyababayeko,
Abayuda bashiraho umugenzo kugira ngo bo bo ubwabo n’abazobakomokako n’abazokwifatanya na bo bose baze bahimbaze iyo misi ibiri uko umwaka uheze, nk’uko vyategekanijwe no mu gihe cashinzwe.

Iyo misi ize yibukwe guhimbazwa uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurakuranwa n’urundi no mu miryango yose, mu ntara zose no mu bisagara vyose. Abayuda ntibaze bigere bibagira guhimbaza iyo misi ya Purimu, canke ngo uruvyaro rwabo ruyibagire.
Nuko umwamikazi Esiteri, umukobwa wa Abihayili, hamwe na Moridekayi Umuyuda, barandika, bakoresheje ububasha bwose, ngo bemeze iryo kete rya kabiri ryerekeye Purimu.
Kandi Moridekayi arungikira amakete Abayuda bose bo mu ntara ijana na mirongo ibiri n’indwi z’ubwami bwa Ahasuwerusi, arimwo amajambo yo kubipfuriza ivyiza no kubaremesha.

Ayo makete yari ayo kwemeza iyo misi ya Purimu n’ibihe yashingiwe, nk’uko Moridekayi Umuyuda na Esiteri umwamikazi bari babishinze, bakayemeza ku bwabo no ku bw’uruvyaro rwabo, bibuka ibihe vyo kwisonzesha no gukoma induru baboroga.
Itegeko rya Esiteri ryemeza ivyo vyashinzwe vyerekeye Purimu, kandi vyandikwa mu bitabu vy’ibigenda biraba.
Umwami Ahasuwerusi ategeka ko mu bwami bwose no mu mazinga ya kure batanga ikori.

Kandi ibikorwa vyiwe vyose vy’inkomezi n’ububasha bwiwe, hamwe n’inkuru yuzuye ivuga ivy’ubukuru bwa Moridekayi ubwo yahawe n’umwami, mbega ntivyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyagenda biraba c’abami b’Abamedi n’Abaperesi?

Moridekayi Umuyuda yari uwa kabiri inyuma y’umwami Ahasuwerusi, akomeye mu Bayuda bose, kandi yari afise icubahiro muri benewabo b’Abayuda, kuko yakora arondera ineza y’ubwoko bwabo kandi akavugira Abayuda ngo babe mu mahoro.
